title: Foundation-model fold-0 screen: can any installable tabular FLM become an 11th ensemble member?
motivation: The champion route arm is TabPFN-v3.5 full-context on the raw-21 view. Five other installable tabular foundation models (TabICL-v2, TabDPT, Causilo, TabFM, xRFM) are untested on S6E10. A model can add ensemble value if it is strong AND decorrelated. This screen measures both on fold 0 before committing to a full 5-fold OOF.

scope.cannot: pass the OOF admission gate; justify a submission; or establish private performance
scope.purpose: decide whether a candidate merits a full 5-fold OOF + admission-gate run

protocol.feature_representation: raw21 + 'Flight Distance coarse10', meta columns label-encoded to codes, fillna(-1) -- built by the champion's own frames() builder (scripts/run_sol_tabpfn.py, route=True)

context.kind: stratified subsample of FIT (folds 1-4) for in-context learning
context.fold_safe: context is a subset of FIT; never contains a fold-0 row

protocol.eval_rows: full fold-0 (~139927) unless --eval-rows caps it (label-agnostic head)

candidate_notes.xrfm: xRFM recursive feature machine (torch kernel machine; inner 15% val split carved from context)
candidate_notes.tabfm: TabFMClassifier (google/tabfm-1.0.0-jax); requires a jax backend -- run separately once jax is installed

decision_rule.note: PROMISING only means 'run full 5-fold OOF + admission gate'; it is NOT admission. The admission gate (mean paired fold gain >= 1.5e-5, >= 2.5x paired SE, positive in >= 4 of 5 folds) still applies and can only be evaluated on full OOF.

anti_leakage: No target encoding is used (raw view only).
Context rows are a subset of FIT (folds 1-4); no fold-0 row is ever in context.
The champion reference (route/portfolio) is loaded from hash-asserted phase17_B1 artifacts (portfolio sha 1981745c..., route sha bcb28113...).
No Atlas diagnostics, no per_row_burden, no stored folds 1-4 predictions are used.

budget.gpu: inference-only on the RTX 5070 Ti (light); <=1 GPU job at a time

predeclared_followups: Any PROMISING candidate gets a full 5-fold OOF with inner cross-fitting and the admission gate.
TabFM runs separately once a jax backend is installed (not installed at prereg time to protect the certified torch stack).
TabPFN-3 vs TabPFN-2.6 checkpoint comparison (item 13) requires downloading additional checkpoints; not part of this screen.
